spec.summary: Three smartphone screenshots consume more input tokens than reading a one hundred page novella.
sources: Standard vision transformer patch breakdown arithmetic

beats.say: Three screenshots cost more tokens than a whole novella.
Vision models chop every image into tiny square patches.
Each fourteen by fourteen pixel grid becomes separate tokens.
Three high resolution screenshots reach forty two thousand tokens.
A thirty thousand word text uses about forty thousand tokens.
The math checks out by pure arithmetic.
Images trick your prompt length limits.
